title: Morning Briefing: Monday 26 October 2026
excerpt: 9 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.
summary: 9 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.
content_html:
9 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.

The stories

  • Free benefits checks at Littleborough and Wardle libraries on Monday and Tuesday Littleborough
    Council advisers will offer free, no booking needed benefits checks at Littleborough Library on 26 October and Wardle Library on 27 October, from 10am to noon.
  • Rochdale Council Tax Direct Debits delayed by one day after system error Rochdale
    Council Tax Direct Debits due on Monday 26 October will instead be collected on Tuesday 27 October, Rochdale Council says. The notice applies to the affected collection date.
  • Wednesday deadline to comment on parking changes in Rochdale, Littleborough and Milnrow Rochdale
    Residents have until Wednesday 28 October to comment on three proposed parking orders affecting Mere Street, Wardle Street and the Butterworth Hall area.
  • New book showcases unseen 1930s photographs of Rochdale's Norden Riviera Norden
    A new book featuring 600 unseen photographs captures the essence of 1930s Rochdale, including the lost Norden Riviera lido, highlighting the area's historical significance during a transformative…
  • New documentary explores the history of Hollingworth Lake Littleborough
    A new YouTube documentary delves into the fascinating history of Hollingworth Lake, revealing its origins and significance to the local community.
  • Road closures for Wardle Remembrance Sunday on 8 November 2026 Wardle
    Rochdale Borough Council has announced road closures in Wardle for Remembrance Sunday on 8 November 2026, affecting local traffic and access.
  • Tree falls across the top of Belfield Road Rochdale
    A large tree has come down at the top of Belfield Road in Rochdale, with its trunk and branches lying across the carriageway and pavement.
  • Rochdale awards event recognises achievements of over 200 cared for children Rochdale
    More than 200 children in care were celebrated at an awards event hosted by Rochdale Borough Council, recognising their achievements and resilience.
  • Rochdale vs Lionesses match postponed due to unforeseen circumstances Rochdale
    The match between Rochdale and the Lionesses, originally set to take place recently, has been postponed. This announcement was made by Salford City FC on their official website.

Weather: Heavy rain 14°C in Rochdale today.

The Morning Briefing is published every day at 9am. Got a story? Tell the newsdesk.
